manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the right arm to put the can with shiny smooth surface in the medium basket with smooth texture; the other arm lifts the medium basket with smooth texture.

Task description: Use the right arm to place the smooth metal can with a red pattern and gold lid on the right side of the table into the medium red-brown basket at the center. The left arm will lift the basket.

Success criteria: The can must be inside the basket, near its body and physically touching it, while the left arm lifts the basket with its opening upright and without excessive tilt. Both basket and can must be clearly higher than their starting positions, with the can no longer touching the table. Holding the can above the basket opening is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Grip straighter middle can sidewalls with the right gripper, avoiding the rolled lid rim. Open slightly wider than the diameter and confirm the fingers straddle it before closing to reduce off-center slipping.
- With the left gripper, consider the thin wall near the middle of the basket's left upper rim, away from handle joints. If clearance permits, use one finger inside and one outside, balancing pad contact area with room in the opening for the right arm.
- When moving the can over the basket rim or handle, leave enough height for its base and make any needed pose adjustment in open space. Avoid catching the base on the basket and tilting it.
- Move the suspended basket smoothly. If it becomes noticeably tilted, first return it to table support and adjust the left gripper contact point rather than releasing while suspended and tipping it over.
- When lowering the jar into the basket, avoid the handle and left gripper. If releasing the right gripper, first confirm that the basket bottom supports the jar securely to avoid dropping, bouncing, or rolling it out.
